test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 09 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A shopkeeper marked the price 18% more than its cost price. If he allows a discount of 24%, then find his loss per cent.
solution:
**Given:**

Marked price = 18% more than its cost price

Discount = 24%

**Formula used:**

S.P. = [(100 - Discount%)/100] x C.P.

Loss% = [(C.P. - S.P.)/C.P.] x 100

Where, C.P. = Cost price, S.P. = Selling price
